title: The Sorting Stones
speaker: kenji
intro: Now — the conveyor jammed with mixed-up rocks. Chomp each one and carry it to its family platform. Igneous from volcanoes, sedimentary from squeezed layers, metamorphic from heat and pressure!
success: Sugoi! Every stone with its family. The conveyor hums happily again.

items.label: Basalt
items.fact: Basalt is lava that cooled quickly — a volcano's leftovers.

items.label: Granite
items.fact: Granite cooled slowly underground, growing sparkly crystals.

items.label: Sandstone
items.fact: Sandstone is layers of sand squeezed together for ages.

items.label: Limestone
items.fact: Limestone is often made from tiny sea shells — fossils love it.

items.label: Slate
items.fact: Slate is mudstone changed by squeezing and heat.

items.label: Marble
items.fact: Marble is limestone transformed deep underground by heat.
